title: Untitled (Figure, Blue Ground)
description: Vertical mixed-media collage on red ground incorporating compact discs at each corner, a floppy disk at bottom center, drawn numerals along the margins, and a central layered column of printed ephemera, braided cord, patterned fabric, and a small biplane image positioned near a photographed face fragment.
composition: axial vertical totem on flat ground

title: Reliquary
description: Lace doilies border a rectangular collage centered on a yellow Latin cross, above which six black vertical bars extend upward, each topped with a silver compact disc. Additional CDs line the lower interior edge and outer border, set against layered translucent fabric with printed text and a violet ground.
composition: centered shrine on dark ground

title: Alley, Magenta Figure
description: Narrow urban alleyway surfaces covered in layered spray-paint murals, including a central white-plastered section depicting a magenta-headed figure wearing oversized purple-and-yellow sunglasses above a skeletal torso in red and black. Flanking walls carry additional multicolored tags and characters; a silver Moto Guzzi Griso motorcycle is parked at the base.

title: Procession
description: Vertical totem composition on pale yellow ground: a warplane photograph positioned at the apex descends through tiered arrangements of gold and silver compact discs, hand-drawn concentric circles, grid-patterned paper strips, and a black photographic band at lower center, flanked by four vertical yellow painted lines.
composition: axial vertical totem on light ground

title: Hieroglyph
description: Collaged layers juxtapose a reproduced Egyptian wall-painting of a seated deity—bearing a solar disc headdress and hieroglyphic register above—with a line-drawn warplane ascending from below. Yellow tape strips run vertically across the composition; compact discs occupy upper corners; a football helmet, iridescent sequin strips, and scattered marbles accumulate at the lower edge.
composition: centered iconographic panel with framing bands

title: Disc Crucifix
description: Mixed-media assemblage incorporating five iridescent compact discs arranged along a T-shaped form above layered panels of reflective black, dark green, and white materials. White cables and wires hang loosely downward from the central structure, alongside small electronic components and blue-painted fragments affixed to the surface.
composition: asymmetric cross at upper left, dripping strings below
central plane on light field, dense base frieze
description: Mixed-media collage centered on a top-down line-drawn warplane over layered CD-R packaging, holographic foil, and iridescent tape. Four Skilcraft compact discs are affixed at corners; a football, red helmet, paper clips, and concentric target forms occupy the lower register alongside yellow-accented gear shapes.
title: Fuselage and Helmet

composition: left-aligned plane with disc and snapshot drift
description: Mixed-media collage incorporating three gold compact discs, a side-view warplane drawing, postage stamps, polaroid-style photographic prints, and multicolored painted ribbons against a predominantly white ground. Concentric target rings appear at upper center and lower left, alongside holographic foil fragments, hand-drawn architectural lines, and bold red, yellow, and black gestural strokes.
title: Untitled (Polaroid Drift)

composition: central plane on stacked targets, axial symmetry
description: Centered top-down outline of a military aircraft overlays concentric black-and-white target rings, surrounded by collaged printed ephemera including gold compact discs, bullseye targets, photographic snapshots, red and orange vertical ribbon forms, and a football, arranged across a dense multi-layered white ground.
title: Bombsight
Yellow Figure on Black Wall
description: Yellow stenciled human silhouette, posed mid-stride, sits centered within a layered spray-painted field of magenta, red, and orange on a black wall covered with overlapping white and turquoise graffiti tags. Small snowman motifs flank the central figure; cyan bubble lettering occupies the lower register alongside a partially visible printed flyer.

Large-scale mixed-media mural covering an entire wall, densely layered with collaged imagery including footballs, concentric target circles, chess pieces, cameras, and photographic fragments rendered in saturated reds, blacks, yellows, and whites. Painted and printed elements overlap continuously across the surface without visible negative space.
title: Installation View, Wall of Works
Guernica, Tall
description: Vertical digital collage bearing the text 'GuErNiCa' in mixed-case letters across a red-and-black urban texture at top; below, mirrored fragmented faces with yellow eyes are overlaid by horizontal color bands—cyan, yellow, red—while warplane silhouettes and compact discs occupy the lower registers against black-and-white photographic strips.
composition: axial vertical totem with text crown

title: Stencil Girl, Brick Wall
description: Black-and-white spray-paint stencil on weathered yellow brick depicting a child's face and torso, holding an object printed with repeating dollar signs rendered in white against black. Two small secondary stencils—a figure with glasses and a three-circle snowman—appear near the upper wall edge.
composition: central stencil on brick wall

title: Cleveland Institute Group Portrait
description: Black-and-white group photograph of approximately fifty individuals posed on exterior steps before a building bearing the inscription 'The Cleveland Institute.' Subjects are arranged across three informal rows, with foliage and large windows visible behind them.
keywords: Cleveland Institute of Art student group photograph

title: Devo at WHK Auditorium
description: Black-and-white concert photograph of Devo performing at WHK Auditorium in Cleveland, 1977. Musicians are visible on stage with equipment and lighting rigs; a large dark tarpaulin or debris field occupies the foreground. Caption credits Photo © 1977 Bobbie Watson.

title: Untitled (Stage Dive)
description: Black-and-white photograph of a figure mid-air above a concert venue stage, captured leaping from elevated scaffolding or speaker stack. Spectators visible at lower right; ornate architectural molding and a lighting rig frame the interior space.

title: Untitled (CD Formation) 2
description: Multiple compact discs mounted on white rectangular bases are arranged in vertical formation against a layered background of red ribbon stripes, blue accents, and translucent brown tones. Iridescent disc surfaces catch light across the composition, interspersed with concentric-ring targets and photographic urban fragments.
composition: vertical CD formation on layered background

title: Untitled (Turquoise Field Drawing) 2
description: Turquoise ground supports dense, layered mark-making in black ink with scattered patches of orange, yellow, green, magenta, and white paint. Gestural stick figures, tree-like forms, a side-profile warplane, and loose schematic drawings are distributed across the wide horizontal composition.
composition: wide horizontal field with scattered mark-making
panoramic wall-spanning layered collage installation
description: Gallery installation view of a large-scale mural-format collage spanning an entire white wall. Visible elements include the text 'XXXIII dias', warplane silhouettes, crosses, palm trees, bullseye targets, concentric rings, and densely layered photographic and painted fragments in red, green, black, and grey.
title: XXXIII Días Installation View
Untitled (Machine Assemblage)
description: Vertical assemblage of mechanical components — cassette decks, disc mechanisms, fan units, and circuit boards — mounted on white fabric with painted vertical color stripes. Red circular outline overlays the upper section; a soccer ball and concentric-ring elements appear at the periphery.
composition: vertical mechanical stack on fabric ground

title: Untitled (Cassette Torso)
description: Two joined cardboard panels shaped into a rough torso silhouette, densely layered with cassette tape components, gold compact discs, soccer balls, ribbon stripes, paper ephemera, and a sequined heart motif. Red and orange vertical ribbon stripes punctuate the composition alongside scattered printed tickets, stickers, and circular disc elements.
composition: torso-shaped panels densely layered with ephemera
keywords: gold disc and ribbon stripe collage

title: Untitled (Assembled Machines)
description: Dense assemblage of found objects and printed ephemera layered across a white ground, incorporating compact discs, circular grilles, vintage camera components, and colored tubing. Vertical yellow, teal, and ochre painted strips divide the composition into irregular columns.
composition: vertical striped columns with layered found objects

title: Clockwork Targets Formation
description: Dense mixed-media painting crowded with bullseye targets, clock faces, concentric rings, and top-down warplane silhouettes distributed across a white ground. Vertical yellow and red blocks anchor the composition alongside mechanical assemblages rendered in black, red, and blue.
composition: dense all-over scatter on white ground

title: Neon City Night Panorama
description: Stylized nocturnal cityscape rendered in flat graphic planes, dominated by dense urban towers with illuminated windows against a deep blue sky. Two pendant lamps hang from above; a horizontal striped railing in multicolor bands occupies the lower third.
composition: horizontal cityscape with foreground railing band

title: Repeated Doll Faces
description: Four repeated photographic prints of a blonde doll face are layered across a densely painted background of yellow, red, and blue. Gestural ink scrawls, neon lines, and fragmented imagery surround the doll heads, creating an agitated, layered surface.
composition: repeated face motif across horizontal plane

title: Untitled (Numan Collage)
description: Mixed-media collage dominated by a bold horizontal red band bearing white cut-leaf forms, above a dense lower zone of silver foil, compact discs, orange triangles, black geometric shapes, and scattered red fragments. Handwritten inscription 'NUMAN' appears at upper right; signed and dated 11/30/2022 at lower right.
composition: horizontal red band over fragmented lower zone

title: Two Faces, One Warplane
description: Vertical composition featuring two stylized human faces connected by a dripping central axis, with a top-down warplane silhouette positioned between them. Energetic gestural lines in primary red, blue, and yellow radiate across a white ground, interspersed with ink drips and splatter.
composition: vertical axis with two faces and warplane

title: Untitled (Warplanes Over Chaos)
description: Panoramic painting on a turquoise ground with gestural ink-drip mark-making in black, red, yellow, and green. Four top-down warplane silhouettes traverse the composition in horizontal formation above abstracted splattered forms, including a central yellow lion-like face.
composition: horizontal warplane formation over gestural abstraction

title: Four Figures, Blue Ground
description: Four figurative panels depict human subjects in dynamic poses against an electric blue ground, each surrounded by fragmented objects including gym equipment, electronics, and scattered debris. Red and orange garments unify the figures across the panoramic composition.
composition: four vertical panels, figures on blue ground

title: Targets, Discs, and Eye
description: Large-scale collage integrating compact discs, bullseye targets, vinyl records, and painted geometric forms across a white ground. Orange tape borders, blue vertical stripes, a drawn eye with triangle surround, flower motifs, and a chess piece anchor the densely layered composition.
composition: dense multi-zone horizontal panorama with layered elements
